scope: Native KiCad project workspace and startup/opening flow based on supplied EasyEDA reference images
acceptance: manual native GUI observations through cua_repl plus native build and filesystem/config readback

checks.evidence: Native GUI shows a permanent Start Page and All Projects / Project Design tabs; Simplified and Traditional Chinese were observed.
Native folder dialog added /tmp/kicad-integration-projects; three complete projects appeared, excluding standalone child schematic.
After a clean GUI restart, the saved root and its three projects reappeared without opening a project.
ecc83-pp_v2 returned one entry; a nonexistent query returned the localized empty result; active project was not changed.
Double-clicking pic_programmer selected Project Design and showed its PCB, schematic, library, and current full path.
Start Page card opened the PCB; native design tree opened the schematic; Window menu listed manager, PCB, schematic together.
With both editors open, switching to All Projects and reopening pic_programmer retained all three windows, verified in the Window menu.
Selecting ecc83-pp and pressing Enter switched the whole project; manager remained open and tree/current path updated.
Double-clicking pic_programmer in the Start Page recent-project table loaded that project.
Right-click Remove Folder from List removed the saved root; current project stayed active and its project file still existed.
cmake --build build --target kicad --parallel 6 exited 0; existing duplicate-library linker warnings only.

Final rebuilt app was launched using the normal user profile; /Users/mosc/Downloads/Kicad/demos was added using the native folder dialog. GUI showed 41 entries (37 scanned projects plus recent entries).

limitations: PCB and schematic editing retain native independent editor windows; they are not embedded as main-window document tabs.
Folder discovery is bounded to depth 8, 100000 entries and approximately five seconds; hidden, build, node_modules and backup directories are skipped.
The prior 971-tool semantic coverage status is not changed by this UI work.
prior_integration_summary: summary.json is the earlier integration snapshot; workspace-ui.json carries the current GUI binary fingerprint.
